additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390529-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946] Session has been interrupted CRM:00641000767
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Please find below the detailed description of the error that has been reported multiple times:
Error Details:
PLC-Error-Flag:
IMD_BC2 changed to true
MB-Er:
0 - No error
IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:
5 - Isolation resistance failure level reached
Capa:
0 - Maximum Y-capacity is not exceeded at the DC output
RlyConn:
1 - Bender Relay iso test is valid
Init:
1 - IMD is initialized, and self-check is performed
SIS (Standby Isolation Status):
3 - Iso fault (Rf < 100kΩ)
Recommended Actions:
Additional Notes:
Please carry a spare
Insulation Monitoring Device (IMD)
during the site visit in case a replacement is necessary.
Kindly note that the charger is out of warranty.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Feel free to contact us if you need further clarification or any other support.
Best regards,
Abhinav Malokar
Siemens eMobility Tech Support Team

additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
As explained by the global team, there has been an IMD DC2 error.
This translates to an insulation resistance fault being detected on the connector 3 (CCS2).
Do you have the make and model of the vehicle that the customer is trying to charge?
You mentioned its their new double decker, is it new in the sense it is another double decker that they already have and use?
Or its a completely new make and model to that site and charger?
Are the other vehicles, (the previous BYD and Yutong), still charging without fault?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch

Application Service Engineer
